title: Can't get it working .. Not user friendly at all
body: Maybe a good app but no use untill I can get it working. So for mr it was total waste of time. Dev team forgot to pilot it to customers so perhaps missed to give any info on how to enable the service. Dissappointed. !

title: Very convenient, Very useful
body:
A very convenient and useful app to meet daily banking needs! it's like having your bank 24/7 with you! 

Excellent work done!! Easy-to-use app and almost like an add on to the banking web site!
